summary: Plan completed: six phases, all cross-cutting (provider reader and opt-in grant; storage-release mirror; freshness rule; shared-module grant as the second HelmCharts push; restore runbook; decision record), the operator's pre-run OpenBao/Roboform list, and 20 criteria in verification.json. The dry-run parses. Planning also settled two things: the grant is gated per cluster through provider configuration, because dev-cluster releases also run stage prd; and a live probe showed the existing rclone-backup image already has what the mirror needs.
